summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a new at-the-market equity program under a second amended and restated sales agreement dated October 9, 2026 with Deutsche Bank Securities as sales agent. Aggregate offering price is capped at $41,371,110, replacing the prior $63,084,580 ATM, under which 937,882 shares for $21,713,470 had been sold. A concurrent $75,000,000 ATM with Jefferies runs in parallel, with orders routed to only one agent daily. Commission is 2% of gross sales price. Common shares closed at $30.47 on Nasdaq on October 8, 2026, alongside a Euronext Athens parallel listing. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
